description:
Requirements: 
 US Citizen. Must be clearable. A clearance or an inactive clearance preferred. Government agency experience required.
 Developer (Flex, ColdFusion) position description: 
 We are seeking an Application Developer to join our team. The developer shall perform and/or support requirements definition, design and prototyping, implementation, unit testing, debugging, verification, deployment, and maintenance activities throughout the software development life cycle (SDLC) for current and future software modules of a comprehensive web portal environment. 

 Please speak to the relevancy of your work experience in your cover letter. 

 Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 
 
 Define requirements, develop designs and prototypes, implement, unit test, debug, verify, deploy, and maintain application software 

 Develop and maintain technical documentation for the developed/maintained functionality.
 Assist other developers, testers, and/or client stakeholders to understand relevant requirements.
 Perform configuration management tasks for in-scope projects.
 Support Adobe Flex and ColdFusion application development. 
 Work Experience: 
 Experience with ColdFusion version 9 and 10 development and maintenance 

 Experience with Adobe Flex development and maintenance
 Experience converting ColdFusion applications into Java
 Superior software programming skills
 Experience recommending changes for improvements in web server configurations  
 JOB SKILLS 
 Enthusiastic, proactive, positive attitude with good listening skills and high integrity
 Excellent organizational skills, strong attention to detail and ability to manage projects supporting multiple organizations effectively
 Ability to synthesize, or combine facts and details from different sources into coherent narratives
 Ability to work under pressure (at times) and be extremely flexible under changing priorities
 Ability to identify innovative ways to solve problems
 ColdFusion versions 9 and 10 development experience
 Adobe Flex development experience
 VMware vSphere versions 5 through 5.5 experience
 Apache Tomcat experience
 Content management system (CMS) experience such as DRUPAL, Joomla, or Word Press
 Configuration Management experience such as Serena CM
 Windows 2008 Active Directory/XP/Win7 experience  
 Certificates, Licenses, and Registrations:
 Relevant programming certifications preferred  
  Communication Skills: 
 Excellent business and technical communication skills including the following:

  Education:
 Bachelor’s Degree required. Computer science, information systems, or engineering fields of study preferred.

 Duration: 3 years 
 
 Need Citizens / Must have an active Secret clearance 
 Share the Profiles to michael(at)tammina.com 

 
 Contact: 703-349-1004 
 
 
 Keep the subject line with Job Title and Location
